summary: FuRyu and Cattle Call's SaGa-influenced RPG about adventurers exploring Avalon, later remastered in HD.

entries.title: The Legend of Legacy
entries.definitive_edition: The Legend of Legacy HD Remastered

emulation.emulator: None for primary; Lime3DS/Azahar for original 3DS comparison

primary.version: The Legend of Legacy HD Remastered
primary.why: The HD Remastered release brings the 3DS original to modern platforms; PC gives the highest capture/settings ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC. PS5 is the strongest console alternative; use 3DS only for original-version comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate story/content-bearing edition is documented beyond the HD remaster.
